description: Metro and train taps: one row per day, per station, per ticket type, 2015-2025. A tap is one person entering a station with a travel card. Before answering, look up warnings_between(start, end) for the period asked about.
Day the taps happened. A transport day runs from 04:00 to 03:59 the next morning.
Year of date.
Month of date, 1-12.
Key of the station in dim_station. Declared as a foreign key, so it always points to a real entry there. Join on this column.
Official station id. Use this, not names, to group by station. Empty when the station is unknown or unmatched.
Official station name, as it is today (from the official station list, 2026). A station renamed since then appears under its current name.

How the station was identified: exact_id (id found in the official list), via_station_code (id changed over time; linked through the station code), unknown_station (IDFM did not know the station), unmatched (no official station found).
Station id exactly as written in IDFM's file. Placeholder values mean unknown: ?  0  999999  -1  or empty.
IDFM's station code exactly as written in its file. ND means unknown.
Station name exactly as written in IDFM's file. Spelling varies across years; do not group by it.
IDFM's numeric code for the transport company. Its meaning is not documented in the data.
Ticket type exactly as written in IDFM's file. The labels changed on 2023-07-01; use ticket_category to compare across that date. Declared as a foreign key to dim_fare_category.label.
Ticket type grouped so it can be compared across the 2023-07-01 relabelling, e.g. Navigo, Imagine R, Solidarité.
How reliably ticket_category follows this ticket type across 2023-07-01: exact, merged (several old types became one), approximate, or no_successor.
Number of taps. Empty when IDFM hid a count below five (see was_hidden): unknown, not zero. SUM ignores empty values.
True when IDFM hid a count below five for privacy (2015 to mid-2017 only). The real number is unknown.
IDFM file this row came from.

Bus and tram taps: one row per day, per line, per ticket type, 2015-2025. On buses and trams people tap inside the vehicle, so taps are counted per line, not per stop. Before answering, look up warnings_between(start, end) for the period asked about.
Day the taps happened. A transport day runs from 04:00 to 03:59 the next morning.
Year of date.
Month of date, 1-12.
Key of the line in dim_line. Declared as a foreign key, so it always points to a real entry there. Join on this column.
Official line id. Use this, not names, to group by line. ? and A00000 mean the line is unknown.
Official line name, as it is today (from the official line list, 2026). Empty for lines not in that list.
Bus or tram, from the official line list. Empty for lines not in that list.
Company running the line, from the official line list. Empty for lines not in that list.
How the line was identified: exact_id (found in the official list), unknown_line (IDFM did not know the line), unmatched (line not in today's list, mostly routes that no longer exist).
Line name exactly as written in IDFM's file. Spelling varies; do not group by it.
IDFM's line code as written in its file. It does not match the official line list; use line_id instead.
IDFM's numeric code for the transport company. Its meaning is not documented in the data.
Ticket type exactly as written in IDFM's file. The labels changed on 2023-07-01; use ticket_category to compare across that date. Declared as a foreign key to dim_fare_category.label.
Ticket type grouped so it can be compared across the 2023-07-01 relabelling, e.g. Navigo, Imagine R, Solidarité.
How reliably ticket_category follows this ticket type across 2023-07-01: exact, merged, approximate, or no_successor.
Number of taps. Empty when IDFM hid a count below five (see was_hidden): unknown, not zero. SUM ignores empty values.
True when IDFM hid a count below five for privacy (2015 to mid-2017 only). The real number is unknown.
IDFM file this row came from.

Share of a typical day's metro and train taps in each hour, per station, per type of day, per half-year or quarter. These are percentages of a day, not counts: they cannot be summed into totals. Use only rows where profile_ok is true.
First day of the half-year or quarter this profile describes.
Last day of the half-year or quarter this profile describes.
Year of period_start.

Station id exactly as written in IDFM's file.
IDFM's station code exactly as written in its file.
Station name exactly as written in IDFM's file.
IDFM's code for the type of day: JOHV, JOVS, SAHV, SAVS, DIJFP. See day_type.
Type of day, in words: weekday or Saturday, inside or outside school holidays, or Sunday/public holiday.
Hour of the day, 0-23 (7 means 07:00-08:00). Empty when IDFM did not give the hour. A missing hour means no taps in that hour, i.e. 0%.
Percentage of the day's taps that happened in this hour.
IDFM file this row came from; the period comes from its name.
Sum of share_pct over the whole profile this row belongs to. Should be about 100.
True when the profile adds up to 99-101% and lists each hour once. False profiles are stacked or incomplete and should be excluded.

Known problems in the data. Each one says when it applies, what it affects and which rows it covers. Do not query this directly for a period: use warnings_between('YYYY-MM-DD', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), which returns every warning overlapping that period.

Table the warning applies to.
First day the warning applies.
